## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- ANS CR planned a total asset value for new investments in RP4 of 69.9M€2022, of which 36.2% relates to new major investments. ANS CR planned 2 new major investments for RP4, of which none have started.

- According to the reporting tables, ANS CR underspent -3.1M€2022 (-8.8%) in costs related to investments in 2025. These amounts must be reimbursed to the airspace users through a reduction of future unit rate(s), unless the NSA decides after consultation with the users, that the ANSP must not reimburse a part of the difference according to article 28 of Regulation (EU) 2019/317.

- ANS CR reported 0.4M€2022 in funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
